jobs.title: EHR Clin Solutions Analyst (Epic Radiant) - ITS-Clin Epic Ancillaries
jobs.description:
**Minimum Qualifications:**


Bachelor’s degree in a related field and five years of related experience. Must possess sufficient educational background and/or experience to conduct clinical applications analysis and/or programming of complex systems, analysis of clinical workflows, implementation of solutions, and knowledge of system adoption strategies. An equivalent combination of education and experience relevant to the role may be considered for this position.

  



**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Healthcare Informatics, Clinical Discipline, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Epic Radiant certification (required or must obtain within designated timeframe).
* Vast experience in EHR/clinical systems analysis, with a strong focus on Epic Radiant or imaging workflows.
* Proven experience leading complex build and implementation projects in a healthcare environment.
* Strong understanding of clinical workflows, radiology/imaging operations, and healthcare regulations.
* Experience with system integrations, interfaces (HL7\), and interoperability concepts preferred.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and clinical stakeholders.

 **Job Summary:**


This position is responsible for formulating and designing specifications for highly complex software and programming applications and/or modifies/maintains existing applications. Investigates, identifies, and implements appropriate solutions for clinical systems to support new and existing initiatives, enhance patient care, increase operational efficiency, and ensure regulatory compliance. Responsible for acquiring an understanding of the assigned system applications, functions, and features end\-users would experience. Participates in and leads workforce groups to identify and employ technical and application initiatives for best practice and enhanced healthcare operations in alignment with UTMB’s mission.

 **Job Duties:**

  

A Radiant EHR Clinical Solutions Analyst is responsible for leading the design, development, and optimization of highly complex Epic Radiant (EHR) applications. This role drives the implementation of clinical technology solutions that enhance patient care, improve operational efficiency, and ensure regulatory compliance. The analyst collaborates with clinical, operational, and technical stakeholders to deliver innovative, scalable solutions aligned with organizational goals.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the design, build, testing, and implementation of Epic Radiant and integrated clinical applications.
* Formulate and define system scope and objectives for complex clinical workflows through research and fact\-finding combined with an understanding of clinical and business systems.
* Analyze, modify, and maintain existing EHR applications to improve functionality, usability, and performance.
* Serve as the primary subject matter expert (SME) for Radiant workflows, system configurations, and optimization initiatives.
* Investigate, identify, and implement technical solutions that support new clinical initiatives, regulatory requirements, and operational improvements.
* Collaborate with physicians, clinicians, and operational leaders to translate clinical needs into system design and configuration.
* Lead and participate in interdisciplinary workgroups and governance committees to drive best practices and standardization.
* Ensure system integrity, data accuracy, and compliance with healthcare regulations (e.g., HIPAA, Joint Commission, CMS).
* Perform system testing, validation, and quality assurance for upgrades, enhancements, and new implementations.
* Develop and maintain system documentation, workflows, and training materials for end users.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and support for application issues, including root cause analysis and resolution.
* Mentor and guide junior analysts and team members in best practices and system knowledge.


1\. EHR Clinical Application Analyst – Least Experienced


2\. EHR Clinical Application Analyst, Senior


3\. EHR Clinical Application Analyst, Lead


4\. EHR Solution Analyst (this position)


5\. EHR Solution Specialist – Most Experienced

 **Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Strong technical, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong customer service orientation with clinical and operational users.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently or collaboratively under time\-sensitive conditions.

 **Salary Range:**


Actual salary commensurate with experience.

 **Work Schedule:**


Partial Remote, on\-site as needed. Monday through Friday, 8 am to 5 pm, and on\-call support for staff as needed. Occasional weekend work to support system upgrades or special projects. Primarily work from home, but expected to go on\-site as needed for support.

 **Equal Employment Opportunity**


UTMB Health strives to provide equal opportunity employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, national origin, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other basis protected by institutional policy or by federal, state or local laws unless such distinction is required by law. As a Federal Contractor, UTMB Health takes affirmative action to hire and advance protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.title: Software Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
Onboarding Specialist

**Location:** Remote


**Employment type:** Full\-time


**Reports to:** Director of Operations

**About the Company:**


Saba Healthcare is a leading SNF operator that has launched a software subsidiary to help post\-acute care organizations improve the way they manage admissions and day\-to\-day workflows. Our customers rely on us to make complex processes easier to manage, easier to measure, and easier for their teams to adopt.

**About the role:**


The Onboarding Specialist will guide new customers from signed agreement through successful adoption. You will learn each customer’s workflow, help configure the platform, coordinate integrations, train users, monitor early usage, and stay engaged after launch to make sure teams are getting value from the product.


This is a customer\-facing, hands\-on role. You will work closely with customer leaders, admissions teams, technical contacts, and our product and engineering teams. The best person for this role is someone that has SNF admissions experience, and is organized, patient, technically curious, comfortable leading training, and able to follow through on details until the customer is truly up and running.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own onboarding projects from kickoff through launch and early adoption.
* Lead discovery sessions to understand customer goals, current processes, systems, users, and success criteria.
* Document customer workflows and translate them into clear configuration and implementation plans.
* Coordinate setup of customer accounts, permissions, workflows, templates, data, and integrations.
* Work with customer IT contacts and our technical teams to troubleshoot connectivity, data exchange, configuration, and workflow issues.
* Create practical implementation timelines, task lists, meeting notes, risk logs, and launch\-readiness checklists.
* Deliver live and recorded training for admissions, clinical, administrative, and leadership users.
* Adapt training to different levels of technical comfort and different customer workflows.
* Follow up consistently with customer teams after training and launch to reinforce adoption and resolve friction.
* Monitor usage, identify gaps, and recommend additional training, configuration changes, or process improvements.
* Maintain accurate customer documentation and communicate status clearly to internal stakeholders.
* Capture customer feedback and recurring issues so product and engineering can improve the platform.
* Help create repeatable onboarding playbooks, training materials, FAQs, and internal procedures as the company grows.

**What success looks like:**

* Customers launch on schedule with clear expectations and minimal avoidable friction.
* Users understand the workflows relevant to their jobs and can perform them confidently.
* Integrations, permissions, configurations, and training requirements are documented and completed accurately.
* Customer adoption continues after go\-live rather than dropping off after initial training.
* Risks and unresolved issues are surfaced early and tracked to closure.
* Each onboarding produces useful feedback that improves the next onboarding.

**Required qualifications:**

* 2\+ years of experience working in skilled nursing admissions, using referral, admissions, EHR, or related healthcare software.
* Experience managing multiple projects, customers, or workstreams at the same time.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort leading meetings and training sessions with both frontline users and executives.
* Strong organization, follow\-through, and attention to detail.
* Technical confidence with web applications, user permissions, data imports, integrations, spreadsheets, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to explain unfamiliar technical concepts in clear, practical language.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while keeping internal and customer stakeholders informed.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Direct experience with admissions, referrals, insurance verification, authorizations, clinical documentation, or census workflows.
* Experience implementing healthcare software or working with EHRs, referral portals, APIs, eFax, or similar systems.
* Experience creating training programs, standard operating procedures, or customer\-facing documentation.

  

Remote position

jobs.title: RHTP Primary Care Implementation Specialist - Temporary
jobs.description:
**Let’s do great things, together!**


**About Moda**  

Founded in Oregon in 1955, Moda is proud to be a company of real people committed to quality. Today, like then, we’re focused on building a better future for healthcare. That starts by offering outstanding coverage to our members, compassionate support to our community and comprehensive benefits to our employees. It keeps going by connecting with neighbors to create healthy spaces and places, together. Moda values diversity and inclusion in our workplace. We aim to demonstrate our commitment to diversity through all our business practices and invite applications from candidates that share our commitment to this diversity. Our diverse experiences and perspectives help us become a stronger organization. Let’s be better together.

  

**Position Summary**



The RHTP Primary Care Implementation Specialist serves as a key liaison between Moda Health and partners at rural hospital\-based primary care clinics on Alaska’s Kenai Peninsula. This role provides technical assistance, subject matter expertise, and project management oversight to advance value\-based payment (VBP) readiness through the National Committee on Quality Assurance (NCQA) Primary Care Medical Home (PCMH) implementation. The position partners with hospital and clinic stakeholders to implement a robust quality improvement and data reporting infrastructure to enable quality measure reporting, support population health management, and prepare clinics for sustainable VBP participation through the NCQA PCMH model.



This is a full\-time position. The ideal candidate will reside in Alaska’s Anchorage/Kenai Peninsula region. *This is a limited duration position contingent on continued receipt of RHTP grant funds.*

  


**Pay Range**



$85,000 \- $87,318\.58 annually (depending on experience)  

Actual pay is based on qualifications. Applicants who do not exceed the minimum qualifications will only be eligible for the low end of the pay range.

  

**Please fill out an application on our company page, linked below, to be considered for this position.**



https://j.brt.mv/jb.do?reqGK\=27785428\&refresh\=true  

  

**Benefits****:**


* Medical, Dental, Vision \& Pharmacy
* PTO and Company Paid Holidays
* 401k \- Matching

  

  

**Required Skills, Experience \& Education:**



* Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Public Health, Public Policy, or Healthcare Administration\-related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.


* 3 \- 5 years of experience working in healthcare, public health, or health\-related community\-based organizations. Experience working in or with rural or underserved communities preferred.


* Familiarity with NCQA PCMH and/or Oregon’s Patient\-Centered Primary Care Home requirements and recognition processes.


* Demonstrated understanding of value\-based payment (VBP) systems and APMs in healthcare settings.


* Knowledge of primary care clinic functions such as case management/care coordination, use of electronic health record (EHR) systems, population health\-level metrics and reporting, behavioral health integration, and collaboration with Traditional Health Workers (THWs).


* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially MS Excel and other reporting software.


* Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience convening diverse stakeholders and facilitating productive virtual and in\-person meetings.


* Ability to manage complex projects, track activities, and meet short and long\-term project milestones.


* Ability to maintain confidentiality and project a professional business image.
  


**Primary Functions****:**



* Serve as subject matter expert to partner hospital organization leadership on all matters related to PCMH recognition and Alternative Payment Model (APM) design and implementation.


* Regularly meet with steering committee composed of executive leadership from both Alaska hospitals, Moda Health subject matter experts, and statewide policy partners to guide PCMH implementation, resolve barriers, and ensure shared ownership of key decisions.


* Use project management skills to create and maintain detailed implementation plan and task trackers across multiple stakeholder organizations.


* Provide technical assistance to partner organizations, enabling achievement of core and elective criteria for PCMH recognition across the concepts of team\-based care and practice organization, knowing and managing patients, patient\-centered access, care management and support, care coordination and transitions, performance measurement and quality improvement, and behavioral health integration.


* Partner closely with Medicaid Quality and Innovation Manager, Grants Management Specialist, and Medicaid Quality Supervisor to support clinical partners in meeting RHTP requirements and timeline.


* Use independent judgment to make key business decisions and provide informed recommendations on PCMH criteria implementation and APM design to partner organizations and Moda Health senior leadership.


* Perform other duties as assigned.
  



Working Conditions \& Contact with Others:


* Office environment with extensive close PC and keyboard use, constant sitting, and frequent phone communication. Must be able to navigate multiple computer screens. A reliable, high\-speed, hard\-wired internet connection required to support remote or hybrid work. Must be comfortable being on camera for virtual training and meetings. Work in excess of standard workweek, including evenings and occasional weekends, to meet business need. Occasional and overnight travel may be required.
* Internally with all Moda departments. Externally with partner healthcare organizations and vendors.

  


**Together, we can be more. We can be better.**

This is applicable to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absences, compensation, and training.
